The cover of Step & Slide Sessions, Vol. 1 shows three dancers in silhouette mid-step against a glowing purple and gold backdrop. It's fresh R&B made for stepping, sliding and urban line dancing, credited to DJ Bombchelle ft. The Groove Society.

Put it on when the furniture gets pushed back on a Saturday night.

On the cover of The Soul Lounge, Vol. 1, a lit candle, a glass of red wine and a gold saxophone sit in a dim lounge with a leather booth behind them. It's neo-soul and jazz R&B from DJ Bombchelle, with Slamdino Entertainment ft. DJ Bombchelle printed on the cover.

Save it for a slow Monday night at home.
